messages:
Amira Gomez: Heads-up - our quickstart JS sample fails on Cloudflare Workers: `ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined` and later `require is not defined`. Deployed with Wrangler and esbuild. Anyone have a checklist for this class of issue?
Jon Carter: Classic Node -> Worker leak. Workers is web-only: no Buffer, no process, no require(). Check bundle for transitive deps like `debug`, `uuid` (CJS), `node-fetch`.
Lily Zhang: for Buffer usage replace with web helpers: `Uint8Array.from(atob(s), c => c.charCodeAt(0))`. For fetch, use the platform `fetch` instead of node-fetch.
Amira Gomez: the sample also does token refresh with `setInterval` in the SDK. That seemed to hang or not trigger consistently in Wrangler. Any pattern for auth on edges?
Jon Carter: edges are short-lived, don't rely on background timers. Switch to on-demand refresh: check expiry at call time and refresh synchronously if needed. Or use short-lived signed tokens and rotate them server-side.
Lily Zhang: build output idea: provide a dedicated `edge.mjs` ESM bundle (esbuild: platform=browser, target=es2020, define process.env) and keep `node.cjs` for Node. Use `exports` in package.json to point `import` users to edge when appropriate.
Jon Carter: runtime detection can help in samples: `const IS_EDGE = typeof process === 'undefined' && typeof WebSocket !== 'undefined'`. But prefer separate builds so consumers don't accidentally pull node shims.
Amira Gomez: TS typing problems reported by users: missing `fetch` types and `crypto` types when they target node. Any quick fixes to include in sample tsconfig?
Lily Zhang: add "lib": ["ES2021","DOM"] to tsconfig or add `/// <reference lib="dom" />` in example files. Also ship our own small `edge-helpers.d.ts` for `randomUUID`, base64 helpers, and an `isEdge()` declaration.
Jon Carter: CI idea: add a fast smoke test using Miniflare or Wrangler in CI to run the samples. That'll catch `process` or `Buffer` leaks early.
Devex-Bot: Added internal note: https://redwood-internal.example.com/devex/edge/sdk-guidance - recommends dual build outputs, tsconfig snippet, and CI smoke test. :white_check_mark:
Amira Gomez: thanks team. I'll open a tiny PR replacing Buffer/node-fetch in the sample, point it at `edge.mjs`, and add the tsconfig note. Will ping when PR is up.
Lily Zhang: happy to review and add the `edge-helpers.ts` helpers to the samples repo.
Amira Gomez: awesome, will link PR here. :thumbsup:
